HADESANCIENTS-BURIED_TREASURE.title: Buried Treasure
HADESANCIENTS-BURIED_TREASURE.descriptio: Whenever you gain [gold]Gold[/gold], gain [blue]{MorePercentGold}%[/blue] more. Whenever you heal, heal [blue]{MorePercentHeal}%[/blue] more. Upon pickup, gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] and heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP.
HADESANCIENTS-FLOOD_GAIN.title: Flood Gain
HADESANCIENTS-FLOOD_GAIN.description: The first time each turn you deal at least [blue]{DamageThreshold}[/blue] Attack damage in a single hit, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
HADESANCIENTS-HIGH_SURF.title: High Surf
HADESANCIENTS-HIGH_SURF.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Whenever you play a Skill, gain [blue]{DexterityThisTurn}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
HADESANCIENTS-HIGH_SURF.flavor: "Flow forth, my niece, and overwhelm all those who stand against us, would you there?"
HADESANCIENTS-HYDRAULIC_MIGHT.title: Hydraulic Might
HADESANCIENTS-HYDRAULIC_MIGHT.descriptio: Your Attacks deal double damage on the first [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turns of combat.
HADESANCIENTS-HYDRAULIC_MIGHT.flavor: "My waves can slam into the land with massive force, especially when I give them a little push!"
HADESANCIENTS-KING_TIDE.title: King Tide
HADESANCIENTS-KING_TIDE.description: At the start of each Normal/Elite/Boss combat, gain [blue]{NormalCombatStrength}[/blue]/[blue]{EliteCombatStrength}[/blue]/[blue]{BossCombatStrength}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
HADESANCIENTS-KING_TIDE.flavor: "A storm is brewing, Niece. Big one, this time, why, even bigger than the last! Prepare!"
HADESANCIENTS-RAZOR_SHOALS.title: Razor Shoals
HADESANCIENTS-RAZOR_SHOALS.description: Choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attacks in your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] them with [purple]Splash[/purple] [blue]{Splash}[/blue].
HADESANCIENTS-RAZOR_SHOALS.flavor: "Even the mortals know the sea is bountiful, yet also capable of deadly force!"
HADESANCIENTS-SEA_STAR.title: Sea Star
HADESANCIENTS-SEA_STAR.description: Whenever you take a combat reward, there is a [blue]{RewardCopyPercentChange}%[/blue] chance for another reward of the same type to appear. Rewards created this way can also trigger this effect.
HADESANCIENTS-SEA_STAR.flavor: "The untold bounties of the sea are yours! Well, one of them, at least!"
HADESANCIENTS-SECOND_WAVE.title: Second Wave
HADESANCIENTS-SECOND_WAVE.description: Every [blue]2nd[/blue] turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards} additional card.
HADESANCIENTS-SECOND_WAVE.flavor: "High tide has come again, my niece! Which is my little way of saying, here we go!"
HADESANCIENTS-SLIPPERY_SLOPE.title: Slippery Slope
HADESANCIENTS-SLIPPERY_SLOPE.description: Your Attacks apply [blue]{FrothToApply}[/blue] [gold]Froth[/gold] on every hit.
HADESANCIENTS-SLIPPERY_SLOPE.flavor: "You are swimming in dangerous waters with such antics, Niece."
HADESANCIENTS-WATER_FITNESS.title: Water Fitness
HADESANCIENTS-WATER_FITNESS.description: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP for each relic you have, including this one. Whenever you obtain a relic, gain [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP.
HADESANCIENTS-WATER_FITNESS.eventDescrip: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP for each relic you have, including this one. (Gain [blue]{TotalHpToGain}[/blue] Max HP.) Whenever you obtain a relic, gain [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP.
HADESANCIENTS-WATER_FITNESS.flavor: "Your injuries shall make you stronger, Niece!"
HADESANCIENTS-WAVE_FLOURISH.title: Wave Flourish
HADESANCIENTS-WAVE_FLOURISH.description: The first time each turn you draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards during your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
HADESANCIENTS-WAVE_STRIKE.title: Wave Strike
HADESANCIENTS-WAVE_STRIKE.description: The [blue]3rd[/blue] Attack you play from your [gold]Hand[/gold] each turn is played an additional time.
